notice: Hand-derived S6 deltas over the accepted v2 golden, plus the S7 stats.tcy schema zero (these inputs have no postfix TCY note). Generated by scripts/specify_v3_delta.py from Python fixtures and literal expectations; never from TypeScript output.

SCHEMA_V3_API.summary: ConversionOptions.sourceFormat/renameToMd and ConversionResult.isMarkdownOutput are removed; the extension is ImportOptions.outputExtension.

OUTPUT_EXTENSION_DECOUPLED.summary: The former TXT gating is removed; every stage runs by its own toggle for every input and output extension.

COMMON_PROTECTION_FOR_TEXT_INPUT.summary: Fence, inline code and frontmatter protection applies to TXT input too (replaces R13 'TXT is not Markdown').

RESIDUAL_SCAN_FOR_TXT_OUTPUT.summary: The residual note scan and REMAINING_AOZORA_NOTES run for TXT output; JobStats counts them after commit.

FRONTMATTER_FOR_TXT_OUTPUT.summary: Frontmatter generation/restoration follows addFrontmatter/addHeaderToBody for TXT output too.

NAMING_BY_OUTPUT_EXTENSION.summary: Only format/path/MIME follow the extension; an input-name reservation may add _converted for one extension only.

OPTIONAL_GAIJI_BOUTEN_HEADINGS.summary: convertGaiji/convertBouten/convertHeadings default true; explicit false leaves those notes unchanged with zero stage stats.

HEADING_LEVEL_MAPPING.summary: headingLevels (default large=2, medium=3, small=4) selects the # count for all heading forms; U+3000 indent is kept.

ALL_OFF_IDENTITY.summary: With the 12 content fields false the core returns the input string unchanged; naming/residual stay read-only.

TCY_POSTFIXED_FORM.summary: Only the postfix note ［＃「対象」は縦中横］ becomes ｟body｠ when body is 1-4 chars from [A-Za-z0-9!?]. Other TCY notations stay for the residual scan and are not counted.

TCY_GENERATED_BASE.summary: TCY runs after gaiji and before emphasis. Only a complete TCY region from this call supplies a base to emphasis, underline and headings. Bouten does not split that region.

TCY_OPTION_AND_STATS.summary: convertTcy defaults true. StageStats.tcy is {converted, unconverted}. Off and protected text count neither. Residual notes are not added to unconverted or to job errors.

TCY_STATS_SCHEMA.summary: Every core result gains stats.tcy. These pipeline inputs have no postfix TCY note, so the counters stay zero and the text is unchanged.

TCY_ALL_OFF.summary: convertTcy is a content field. All-off identity includes it. MD and TXT output stay the same.
